stories.headline: Romania's post-censure government formation reaches deadlock as Cotroceni consultations begin
stories.summary: Ten days after the Bolojan government was toppled by a PSD-AUR motion of censure, President Nicușor Dan convened formal consultations with all parliamentary parties on Monday to designate a new prime minister. No party can assemble a clear majority: PNL and USR refuse any government including PSD, PSD insists on rebuilding the old coalition without Bolojan, and AUR conditions its support on naming its own premier. Technocrat options including IMF alumna Delia Velculescu are circulating informally. The political landscape is further complicated by internal PNL tensions (Ciucu threatening a party congress), PSD-AUR cooperation on parliamentary votes, AUR's 32% poll lead, and competing analyses of how President Dan is handling the mandate process.

stories.headline: B9+Nordic Summit in Bucharest introduces 'NATO 3.0' concept with Zelenski and Rutte attending
stories.summary: President Nicușor Dan hosted the Bucharest Nine and Nordic countries summit at Cotroceni Palace on May 13–14, attended by NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, Ukrainian President Zelenski, and multiple Central and Eastern European heads of state. The joint declaration committed eastern flank and Nordic leaders to building a 'NATO 3.0' — a stronger European pillar within the transatlantic alliance — while reaffirming the US-Europe security bond. Rutte said Russia remains NATO's 'direct threat' and praised Romanian defense spending.

stories.headline: BNR holds key rate at 6.5% as inflation hits 10.7% and economy contracts
stories.summary: The National Bank of Romania's board voted on May 15 to hold the policy rate at 6.50% for a seventh consecutive meeting, citing high inflation (10.71% in April, driven by energy and fuel prices) set against a contracting economy and political uncertainty. BNR Vice-Governor Cosmin Marinescu warned publicly that the ongoing political crisis is compounding already-deteriorated economic fundamentals. The leu weakened slightly against the dollar in the period.
